method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: get_house_availability
tools.description: Check availability and pricing for a Le Collectionist property over a given period. Returns whether the property is bookable online and its public price if available.

house_name.description: Name of the property (partial match accepted, case-insensitive)

currency.description: Currency code (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF…). Defaults to EUR.
